services.name: SAMU
services.when: Ambulance and medical emergencies, nationwide, answered by Ministry of Health staff. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: Bomberos
services.when: Emergency calls answered by the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Chile: fires and accidents. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: Carabineros de Chile
services.when: Emergency calls answered by Carabineros: robberies, assaults, traffic and other events that seriously affect people. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: Policía de Investigaciones (PDI)
services.when: Emergency calls answered by the Policía de Investigaciones. The crime-report page of ChileAtiende also gives it for crimes in progress. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: Incendios forestales (CONAF)
services.when: Emergency calls about forest fires, and reports of them. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: Búsqueda y Salvamento Marítimo (Armada de Chile)
services.when: Emergency calls answered by the Armada de Chile: accidents on beaches and rocks, port accidents, ships in distress and similar. Free: calls to emergency numbers are exempt from payment (Decreto 18 of 2014, art. 21). From a landline or a mobile, dial only the number (Decreto 747 of 2000, art. 15).

services.name: CITUC (Centro de Información Toxicológica, Universidad Católica)
services.when: Poisoning. Its page does not say whether it covers the whole country. For a life-threatening poisoning call SAMU 131 first.

services.name: Línea de Prevención del Suicidio (Ministerio de Salud)
services.when: Free, confidential support from trained staff, 24 hours every day. For danger right now, call SAMU 131.
